0022600087.text: Both the Charlotte Hornets and Brooklyn Nets open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with Charlotte on the road. The Hornets are missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee), while the Nets are without Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder). Charlotte won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and its most recent meeting was a 117-86 win in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026.
